query:
SELECT 
  u.id as userId,
  u.email,
  u.name,
  u.creditsSubscription as currentCredits,
  s.plan,
  s.status as subscriptionStatus,
  s.startDate,
  s.endDate
FROM users u
INNER JOIN subscriptions s ON u.id = s.userId
WHERE s.status = 'active' 
  AND s.plan IN ('basic', 'professional', 'enterprise')
  AND u.creditsSubscription = 0
ORDER BY s.startDate DESC;
